description: January 1 birthday meaning: Capricorn decan 2, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a January 1 birthday falls in Capricorn, in the second decan, with Saturn as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Capricorn is cardinal and earth.

sections.heading: The January 1 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: New Year's Day lands about ten degrees into Capricorn, in the decan that astrologers traditionally colour with Venus. Saturn's cardinal earth sign supplies the long view; the Venus sub-ruler adds taste, patience with craft and an eye for quality. Birthday number 1 sharpens the picture: someone often described as a self-starter who prefers to set the standard rather than inherit it.

Astronomically, January 1 puts the Sun near 10° Capricorn in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Venus. In the middle of Capricorn, from 10 to 19 degrees, Venus acts as sub-ruler, borrowed from Taurus. Birthdays from about January 1 to January 10 tend to soften the Goat's seriousness with an appreciation of comfort, quality and beauty. These Capricorns are often pictured as both ambitious and sensual: they want to build something, and they want it well made and pleasant to live with. Loyalty in relationships is usually strong. Venus can make material security feel especially important. Remembering that enjoyment is part of success, not a reward postponed for later, often brings this decan balance.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for January 1
paragraphs: Born on the 1st, your birthday number is a plain 1, with no compound behind it. In Pythagorean numerology the day of birth is a secondary number, a talent or flavour that sits alongside the Life Path rather than replacing it. A first-of-the-month birthday is traditionally read as the purest form of initiative: a self-starting streak, a preference for making decisions personally and a comfort with going first. Because there is nothing to reduce, the energy is often described as direct and uncomplicated. The usual counsel is to pair that independence with listening, so leadership does not become lonely.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a January 1 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous January 1 birthdays
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 1 is the 1st day of the year. Counting forward, the next sign change, into Aquarius, is usually complete within 20 days, by January 21.

In the Chinese zodiac a January 1 birth comes before the new year has turned, so the animal is the one that began the previous winter. Among the best-known people with a January 1 birthday are J. D. Salinger (1919), Pierre de Coubertin (1863) and Omar al-Bashir (1944).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 1?
faq.answer: January 1 is Capricorn in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Capricorn, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 1?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 1 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 11 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 1st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 1?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, January 1 always falls before Lunar New Year, which arrives between January 21 and February 20, so someone born on this date takes the animal of the previous calendar year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 1?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on January 1 include J. D. Salinger (1919), Pierre de Coubertin (1863) and Omar al-Bashir (1944). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
